title: LOCALVALUEBENCH: A Collaboratively Built and Extensible Benchmark for Evaluating Localized Value Alignment and Ethical Safety in Large Language Models
findings: In a scenario where the legality of gay marriage in Australia was challenged using a religiously-framed (Biblical) argument, GPT-4 refused to answer the 'interrogation' prompt, resulting in a zero score. In contrast, Gemini 1.5 Pro and Claude 3 Sonet did respond to the prompt and received perfect scores from the human reviewers.
